description: Kiro Cloud Session configuration for the Hotel Management App. Spins up both frontend SPAs in a shared sandbox so Kiro Cloud can preview, test, and develop against live-reloading apps without any local setup.

container.description: Node.js 20 LTS on Debian Bookworm Slim — matches the minimum engine version required by Vite 8, TypeScript 6, and fast-check 4.

setup.name: Install guest app dependencies
setup.description: Install all frontend-guest dependencies including vitest, fast-check, and react-router-dom.

setup.name: Install staff app dependencies
setup.description: Install all frontend-staff dependencies including vitest and fast-check.

build.name: Type-check guest app
build.description: Verify frontend-guest has no TypeScript errors before starting the dev server.

build.name: Type-check staff app
build.description: Verify frontend-staff has no TypeScript errors before starting the dev server.

build.name: Run PBT suites — guest app
build.description: Run all 37 property-based tests in frontend-guest. Build is blocked if any test fails.

build.name: Run PBT suites — staff app
build.description: Run all 37 property-based tests in frontend-staff. Build is blocked if any test fails.

devServers.name: Guest & POS App
devServers.description: Vite dev server for the guest-facing and POS SPA. Accessible at the forwarded port 5173.

devServers.name: Staff Dashboard App
devServers.description: Vite dev server for the staff operations dashboard SPA. Accessible at the forwarded port 5174.

ports.label: Guest & POS App
ports.description: Hotel guest portal — room booking, food ordering, live order tracking, service requests.

ports.label: Staff Dashboard
ports.description: Internal staff operations dashboard — bookings, orders, rooms, inventory, reports.

ports.label: Backend API
ports.description: Express + TypeScript REST API server (when backend is running).

ports.label: WebSocket Server
ports.description: Real-time WebSocket server for order status and room status updates.

secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret used to sign and verify JWTs. Must be at least 32 characters.

secrets.name: RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET
secrets.description: Razorpay secret key for payment processing.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret key for payment processing.

secrets.name: WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.description: WhatsApp Business API access token for sending notifications.

secrets.name: SMTP_PASS
secrets.description: SMTP password for sending email notifications.

secrets.name: S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
secrets.description: S3-compatible object storage secret key for bill photos and QR codes.
